title: NO ONE WILL STAND AGAINST YOU

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "No one will be able to stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you." — Josh 1:5 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is the heart of everything God says to Joshua. The strength Joshua would need did not come from his own ability, his army, or his experience. It came from one fact: "I will be with you."

This was spoken directly to Joshua for a specific mission. Yet the New Testament lifts the very last line of this verse and applies it to every believer. The writer of Hebrews quotes it: "Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you," and then tells us why it matters — "So we say with confidence, 'The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid'" (Heb 13:5-6). What God promised Joshua about His presence, He confirms to us in Christ.

Notice, God did not promise Joshua an easy road with no enemies. He promised that no enemy would ultimately succeed against him, because God Himself would be there. That is a very different thing. You may face real opposition today. God does not always remove the battle, but He never sends you into it alone.

The presence of God is the believer's true security. In Jesus, God came to be "Immanuel — God with us" (Matt 1:23), and by His Spirit He is with us still.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you tend to measure your strength by your circumstances or by God's presence?
2. What battle are you facing that you have been trying to fight alone?
3. How does knowing God will never forsake you change how you face today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that Your presence goes with me. When I am afraid, remind me that You will never leave me nor forsake me. Amen.
